do_examples: Our leaves are picked by hand in the first flush.
Steep for three minutes and notice the colour change.
dont_examples: OMG the BEST tea you will EVER drink!!!

rules.text: Write in a calm, precise voice. No hype, no slang and no corporate jargon.
Never use exclamation marks and never use all-caps for emphasis.
Only make product claims listed in the approved claims register. No unqualified superlatives.

glossary.reason: We sell whole leaf tea, and slang is off-brand (Terminology §2.1).
We say 'guests' for the people we serve (Terminology §2.2).

claims.text: Our leaves are picked by hand on two family estates in Darjeeling
Every tin is plastic-free and fully recyclable
Packed within 72 hours of the final drying
